justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: No outcome studies comparing certified vs non-certified pediatric OT.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: AOTA BCP exam plus experience documentation; significant investment comparable to ABPTS board cert.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to any pediatric OT caseload; useful in school-based, early intervention, and peds outpatient settings.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Pediatric OT billing standard; BCP does not provide a billing premium in most payer contracts.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Valued in pediatric OT settings; moderate employer demand in children's hospitals and school-based programs.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Families value credentialed specialists for children with complex needs.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: OT pediatric cash-pay exists in sensory, feeding, and autism niches but the majority of pediatric OT runs through insurance and schools.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: AOTA/NBCOT board certification supports premium positioning in concierge pediatric OT.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Uncommon among OTs — clearly differentiating in pediatric markets.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Pediatric OT practices can scale with credentialed clinicians, though reimbursement constrains margins.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Parents seek pediatric OT specialists but don't recognize the specific board cert name.
justifications.business.efficiency: Portfolio-based AOTA pathway is rigorous and multi-year.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: AOTA Board Certification in Pediatrics is a top-tier academic credential for OT faculty.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Holders are well represented in AJOT and pediatric OT research circles.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Aligns directly with required pediatric MOT/OTD content including sensory integration and developmental practice.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Underlying pediatric OT evidence is solid in some areas (CIMT, feeding) and weaker in others (some SI claims).
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Commonly preferred for pediatric OT faculty postings.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Portfolio process is time-intensive but doesn't require residency, making it slightly more efficient than PCS.
